name: Disclosure
summary: Shows and hides content that most people don't need, such as “Set a new password instead”. Pressing it toggles the content, and screen readers hear whether it's open.

when: For a less common choice that would distract most people, such as “Create another Atmosphere account anyway”.
For extra options under the main one.

whenNot.text: For content most people need. Show it instead.
For long technical content, such as on the Connect page.

anatomy.description: A button with the summary and a chevron.
Says what's hidden, such as “Set a new password instead”.
Points down when closed and up when open. Decorative.
What's shown when open, directly after the trigger.

props.name: variant
props.description: How much the trigger stands out.

values.description: A bordered bar, as a full-width option.
Underlined text, for a quiet option under the main one.

states.name: Closed
states.description: The content is hidden, and the chevron points down.

states.name: Open
states.description: The content is shown, and the chevron points up.

states.name: Hover
states.description: The trigger's surface or underline darkens.

states.name: Focus
states.description: A 2px focus ring around the trigger.

accessibility.name: Its summary.

keyboard.action: Opens or closes it. Focus stays on the trigger.

screenReader: Announced as a button with its summary, and “collapsed” or “expanded”.
notes: The content follows the trigger in reading order, so it's found straight after opening.
The chevron turns with the motion tokens, so it doesn't animate for reduced motion.

related.relationship: For longer hidden content, such as technical details.
For actions that change the page.

guidelines: Say what's hidden, as an option: “Set a new password instead”.

evidence.point: The disclosure pattern: a button with aria-expanded that controls the content.
